objective: Determine which binary tables on ordered prime-field pairs give identical integer counts or count parities under all one-coordinate crossing tests. Characterize the missing direction and the relevant characteristic.
status: Proved: Exact counts can exchange only equally many full and empty difference classes. Parity permits complementing an even collection of classes. Distinct tables agreeing on both parity and existence must realize every measured label, and the only size-p table with such a competitor is one whole class.
title: Which changes preserve every crossing count?
